scientific_question: Can Tlaloc recover end-to-end capability by removing operations from Parrot and executing memory/control/localization/normalization/verification externally?

depends_on.P0: frozen end-to-end benchmark (30 IMAGE variants, referenced by hash, never copy-edited)

primary_dataset.denominator: the same 30 frozen P0 image-variant questions across every condition
primary_dataset.expected_answer_exposure: never available to any executor; used only for post-hoc scoring after a condition's pipeline has finished

reused_infrastructure: internal/blackboard (Store, Entry, Observation, Consolidate; extended with Fact/EntryFact)
internal/pdfmemory (Search, Load, ReadRegion) for the real (non-oracle) Region Tlaloque
internal/runrecord for accounting (available to the run command; not yet wired into every record)

integrity_checkpoint: after T0-A, verify: 30 paired cases present, all conditions correctly paired, no GT answer leaked, same questions, same expected answers, frozen artifacts unchanged, no retries outside preregistered policy, no transport errors hidden, crop actually contains intended evidence, no scoring denominator bug, no condition-specific prompt drift. Only on a clean pass does T0-B proceed.
